title: Flouting of Guidelines for Use of Light-emitting Wreaths and Inflatables at Funeral Wakes
what_it_is: Flouting of Guidelines for Use of Light-emitting Wreaths and Inflatables at Funeral Wakes

sections.label: Funeral wake wreath guidelines feedback
sections.summary: NEA worked with Town Councils and land agencies to promulgate guidelines on light-emitting wreaths and inflatables at funeral wakes, and feedback decreased after issuance.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Sustainability and the Environment (Mr Baey Yam Keng) (for the Minister for Sustainability and the Environment)
sentences.text: NEA has worked with the Town Councils and land agencies, which issue permits for wakes held in public residential estates, to promulgate these guidelines through the terms and conditions of these permits.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Sustainability and the Environment (Mr Baey Yam Keng) (for the Minister for Sustainability and the Environment)
sentences.text: From June 2022 to April 2023, NEA received about three cases of feedback per month on the use of light-emitting wreaths and inflatables at funeral wakes.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Sustainability and the Environment (Mr Baey Yam Keng) (for the Minister for Sustainability and the Environment)
sentences.text: Since the issuance of the guidelines to stakeholders, NEA and AFD have observed a decrease in feedback received.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Sustainability and the Environment (Mr Baey Yam Keng) (for the Minister for Sustainability and the Environment)
sentences.text: Feedback providers were mainly concerned with the excessive number of light-emitting wreaths and leaving them turned on after 10.00 pm.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Sustainability and the Environment (Mr Baey Yam Keng) (for the Minister for Sustainability and the Environment)
sentences.text: NEA will continue to work with stakeholders to monitor the situation and review the guidelines if necessary.

sections.label: Permit conditions incorporate guidelines
sections.summary: Town Councils and land agencies have incorporated the guidelines' requirements into their permit conditions.

sentences.speaker: Mr Baey Yam Keng
sentences.text: Since the issuance of guidelines, the Town Councils and land agencies have incorporated the requirements within the guidelines into the conditions of their permits.

sections.label: Funeral directors and wreath suppliers checks
sections.summary: NEA worked with funeral directors and wreath suppliers to check site conditions and existing light-emitting wreaths before taking orders, and will monitor and review the guidelines.

sentences.speaker: Mr Baey Yam Keng
sentences.text: Therefore, we also worked concurrently with the funeral directors and the wreath suppliers.

sentences.speaker: Mr Baey Yam Keng
sentences.text: They are supposed to concurrently check in with the families on the site conditions and on how many light-emitting wreaths are already placed there, and only take on the orders when the conditions permit for them to deliver the wreaths.

sentences.speaker: Mr Baey Yam Keng
sentences.text: NEA will continue to monitor the situation with various stakeholders and review the guidelines, if necessary.
